message.content:
A vertical magazine cover features a large yellow title, "TEMPO", positioned at the top center. Below it, in white, is the text "EDISI 21-27 JANUARI 2013". Above the title are two smaller headlines: "TERSEBAB CAMRY DI KOMNAS HAM" on the left and "BEREBUT LUKISAN WIDAYAT" on the right. 

The central image depicts a large, weathered teal excavator arm and bucket positioned on the left, angled toward the bottom center. The metal surface is chipped and stained with brown mud. To the right, a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers stands with his hands on his hips. He is looking downward toward the ground. He stands in a muddy landscape next to some white material, possibly bags or tarps. In the background are green trees and foliage.

Across the center, large white text reads "BANJIR MASALAH 100 HARI JOKOWI". In the bottom left corner, small white text lists the price "RP 29.700", a website, and an ISSN number. A barcode with the number "00047" is at the bottom. The entire image is framed with a red border on the left and bottom.
